| Scale | Wavelength | Sigma | Kernel size at angle 0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 4 | 2.249 | 15 x 15 |
| 1 | 8 | 4.497 | 29 x 29 |
| 2 | 16 | 8.995 | 55 x 55 |

The default bank: smallest wavelength 4, 3 scales with factor 2, 4 orientations, bandwidth 1 octave and aspect ratio 1. For a bandwidth of 1 octave, sigma is (1 / pi) sqrt(ln 2 / 2) (2 + 1) / (2 - 1) = 0.5622 times the wavelength. The angles are 0, 45, 90, 135 degrees, so the bank holds 12 filters. The largest kernel sets the halo of 27 pixels.
